approval_rule: 2026-11-19, repository owner: no separate executor and approver, no named approval or formal sign-off. The repository owner decides; a status changes when evidence that can be checked is in the repository (what was run, on which commits and images, what was seen), not when someone signs.

runtime_verification_notes.rule: RUN means it was run and the evidence is in the repository; it is not a statement that everything passed. What was seen, and what was not shown, is listed per item. Changed from NOT_RUN on 2026-11-19 by decision of the repository owner (see approval_rule).

agentgateway.seen: The pinned agentgateway 1.7.0, real binary and real image. Black-box suite: 97 cases, 96 pass. Single-host pool suite: 30 cases, three rounds.
reservations: In the black-box suite Gatekeeper and the provider are stand-ins.
The image signature was not verified.

gatekeeper_extauthz.seen: A real Gatekeeper at commit f36dc06 run on the development machine: tokens it signs are verified by the gateway, gateway-authz asks its PDP with a client certificate. 12 of the 12 default cases pass.
reservations: It is a local instance with local changes (provider_account type, the dedicated audience by a global switch, a TLS terminator in front of the PDP), not an environment run by the Gatekeeper team.
No environment claim in the token.

The key-rotation case (GK-12) is not among the default cases and failed when it was last run, on 2026-11-11: a token signed with a new key was not accepted within the 60 seconds the case allows, only after the gateway fetched the JWKS again on its own schedule.
The provider in that suite is a stand-in.

provider_sandbox.seen: The WanbExpress sandbox through the whole chain (real Gatekeeper as above, real agentgateway, gateway-authz), from a local gateway and from the single-host pool behind its egress rules: whoami, create, get, delete, revocation. No check failed.
reservations: One sandbox account: isolation between two accounts is shown at a stand-in only.
The sandbox is plain HTTP: TLS to the carrier was not shown.
What the carrier receives, credential rotation and the unknown outcome of a write are shown at a stand-in only.

p1_credential_injection.agentgateway_version_targeted: 1.7.0 (pinned in deploy/agentgateway/agentgateway.lock.json: the upstream container image by digest, and the SHA-256 of the binary inside it, which is the build the suites start; origin, licence and known vulnerabilities checked once on 2026-11-11 as recorded in deploy/agentgateway/README.md; image signature not verified; no separate approval step)
p1_credential_injection.gatekeeper: MOCK (no Gatekeeper implementation was available; mutual TLS to the mock is real)
